_comment: Shared test vectors for the ears <-> core protocol. Both test suites load this file. Change it only together with ears/src/protocol.ts and core/src/dmbot/ears/protocol.py.

hello._comment: What ears sends first: helloMessage(secret, {count, ids}) in ears, parse_ears_message in core.

health._comment: What ears sends when an utterance ends having lost frames to a decrypt failure, a decoder error and a busy link (ears/test/voice.test.ts builds exactly this); parse_ears_message in core reads it. The three counts are optional and omitted when zero.
